oracle.addon: @roamhq/wrtc 0.10.0 (npm; lockfile-pinned in the lab, resolved from registry.npmjs.org)
oracle.method: Each probe ran 21 times under the Node oracle with the addon installed. The stdout of all 21 runs was byte-identical (MEASURED, lab/out/node). stdout is the first run. stderr and exit code are recorded as well. The probes live in tests/fixtures/wrtc/probes/ and are compiled by scriptc WITHOUT the addon present, so the shipped ambient declarations apply.
oracle.excluded: ch.id: uninitialised memory in the oracle (p-sync header). bufferedAmount VALUE: not scored, only its type (p-buffered header). The ctl-* lab probes are refusal controls, not oracle cases.
